next.reason: 1985: "MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1"; 2023: "`MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1` or `MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1`". The MOVE-then-WRITE equivalence for FROM is kept, but 2023 adds a case: FROM literal-1, equivalent to MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1. The 1985 rule covers only identifier-1.
